ai_summary: Adani Power Limited reported exceptionally strong consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing 44% year-over-year and net profit soaring 141% for the quarter, primarily driven by strategic acquisitions like Jaiprakash Power Ventures and new atomic energy subsidiaries. A significant material impact is a one-time tax reversal of over INR 1,200 crores relating to earlier years, which substantially reduced current tax expenses and boosted net profit, warranting further clarification on its non-recurring nature as a potential red flag.
